1a2b-guess.name: 1A2B Number Guessing Game (Bulls & Cows)
1a2b-guess.intro: Classic Bulls & Cows guessing game with 4- and 5-digit difficulty levels, xAyB feedback, candidate-number reasoning help and a best-score record.

2048-game.name: 2048 Game
2048-game.intro: Merge numbered tiles on a 4x4 grid by swiping: combine equal numbers to build up to 2048. Keyboard and touch both supported, fully playable offline.

anagram-game.name: Anagram Game
anagram-game.intro: Given a set of letters, find every English word of three letters or more that can be formed, sorted by length or alphabetically — for word games and brain training.

analysis-4.name: Blood Type Personality Analyzer
analysis-4.intro: Built-in personality descriptions for blood types A, B, O and AB: pick a type to see its trait tags. Entertainment reference only, not a scientific assessment.

analysis-tester-rhythm.name: Typing Rhythm Analyzer
analysis-tester-rhythm.intro: Records the interval between consecutive keystrokes and scores your typing rhythm on beat stability and evenness — useful as rhythm feedback during typing practice.

bbq-portion.name: BBQ Portion Estimator
bbq-portion.intro: Estimate how much meat, seafood, vegetables and charcoal you need per guest for a barbecue, so you neither run short nor overbuy.

bingo-generator.name: Random Bingo Card Generator
bingo-generator.intro: Generate printable random number cards for classroom roll call, event grouping and party games. Everything is produced locally and downloadable.

blink-counter.name: Blink Counter
blink-counter.intro: Pick a duration, tap the button each time you blink, and see your blinking rate — around 15 to 20 blinks per minute is typical for a healthy adult.

blood-type-personality.name: Blood Type Personality
blood-type-personality.intro: Explore the traits, strengths, weaknesses and interpersonal compatibility of blood types A, B, O and AB. Provided for entertainment only.

breakout.name: Breakout
breakout.intro: Classic Breakout: move the paddle with mouse or keyboard to bounce the ball and clear every brick above. Runs entirely in your browser.

chess-fen-viewer.name: Chess FEN Viewer
chess-fen-viewer.intro: Paste a FEN string and the position is parsed and drawn in the browser — side to move, castling rights, en passant target and move counters included.

click-speed.name: Click Speed Test
click-speed.intro: Click as fast as you can within the time limit; the tool shows total clicks and live clicks-per-second (CPS) to test your hand speed and reaction limits.

coin-flip.name: Coin Flip
coin-flip.intro: Tap to get heads or tails instantly for two-way decisions, game rulings and random draws. Runs locally with no data uploaded.

coin-toss-streak.name: Coin Toss Streak
coin-toss-streak.intro: Simulates repeated coin tosses and tracks heads/tails streaks, showing streak counts and their distribution. A casual game that works offline.

color-guess.name: Color Guess
color-guess.intro: A random swatch appears and you name the color or its HEX code, with instant scoring — trains color recognition for design and art work.

color-memory.name: Color Memory (Simon)
color-memory.intro: Watch and repeat a gradually growing color sequence to challenge short-term memory and reaction speed. Levels ramp up and it works fully offline.

convert-speed-stride.name: Stride & Speed Converter
convert-speed-stride.intro: Estimate walking or running speed from cadence and step length, or work backwards from a target speed to the cadence you need — for pacing and gait analysis.

cps-test.name: CPS Test
cps-test.intro: Click as fast as possible within the set time; the tool counts clicks and grades you as slow, average or good against CPS thresholds so you can compare hand speed.

daily-riddle.name: Daily Riddle Challenge
daily-riddle.intro: One shared riddle per day worldwide, with three difficulty levels, tiered hints, combo scoring and an answer calendar. The puzzle bank keeps growing.

emoji-memory.name: Emoji Memory Game
emoji-memory.intro: Match pairs of Emoji across increasing levels to train visual memory and concentration. Runs entirely in the browser and offline.

fingerprint-types.name: Fingerprint Pattern Types
fingerprint-types.intro: Human fingerprints fall into three basic patterns — whorl, loop and arch. Switch between them to see each pattern's features and diagram.

generator-2.name: Sudoku Generator & Solver
generator-2.intro: Generate Sudoku puzzles at several difficulties complete with reference solutions, or paste an existing puzzle to solve it — for practice and leisure.

generator-3.name: Maze Generator (Auto-solve)
generator-3.intro: Generates a random maze and solves it with BFS and A*, with an adjustable grid size. Created and solved locally in the browser.

generator-laugh.name: Laugh Sound Generator (Web Audio)
generator-laugh.intro: Synthesizes a variety of laughs in real time with the Web Audio API, with randomized parameter tweaks and downloadable output.

gomoku.name: Gomoku (Five in a Row)
gomoku.intro: Play Gomoku on a standard 15x15 board in two-player or AI mode; the engine evaluates open fours, open threes and other shapes heuristically.

gomoku-ai.name: Gomoku AI
gomoku-ai.intro: Play against a heuristic Gomoku AI on a 15x15 board. The engine scores open fours, open threes and other patterns to choose its moves.

hangman.name: Hangman Word Game
hangman.intro: Guess the hidden word letter by letter with a limited number of misses and a tracked win/loss record — good for English vocabulary practice and leisure.

hotpot-portion.name: Hot Pot Portion Estimator
hotpot-portion.intro: Estimate how much meat, seafood, vegetables and dipping sauce to buy per person for a hot pot meal, so the table is neither short nor wasteful.

keyboard-heatmap.name: Keyboard Heatmap
keyboard-heatmap.intro: Type in the box below and see a live heatmap of your key distribution. The data stays in your browser and nothing is uploaded.

laugh-generator.name: Laugh Sound Generator
laugh-generator.intro: Synthesizes various laughs in real time with the native Web Audio API — no audio files needed, everything is generated locally.

maze-generator.name: Maze Generator
maze-generator.intro: Generates a maze of the size you choose and lets you walk it with the keyboard, with a built-in auto-solve path hint. Useful for puzzles or algorithm demos.

meditation-timer.name: Meditation Timer
meditation-timer.intro: Set a meditation length with optional interval bells and a closing chime; session counts are kept locally so you can track your practice.

memory-game.name: Memory Match Game
memory-game.intro: Flip two cards at a time to find matching pairs; clear the whole board to win. Trains memory and plays offline.

minesweeper.name: Minesweeper
minesweeper.intro: Classic Minesweeper in three difficulties: use the number clues to deduce and flag every mine, then uncover all safe cells to win. Fully offline.

number-guess.name: Number Guessing Game (1-100)
number-guess.intro: A number from 1 to 100 is chosen at random; you guess and get higher/lower hints, with the number of attempts and your best score tracked.

othello.name: Othello / Reversi
othello.intro: Place a disc to flip the opponent's discs caught between yours; whoever holds more discs when the board fills wins.

pattern-memory.name: Pattern Memory
pattern-memory.intro: A grid pattern flashes briefly and you rebuild it, with difficulty ramping up to test visual memory. Level progress is recorded.

pong.name: Pong
pong.intro: Classic Pong with two-player and AI modes; first to 11 points wins. Pure front-end with no install, playable offline.

raffle-picker.name: Event Raffle Picker
raffle-picker.intro: Import or type in a name list and draw winners at random, with weighting and no-repeat options and a publicly reproducible process — for annual parties, classrooms and team events.

random-name-gen.name: Random Name Generator
random-name-gen.intro: Generate random names in bulk for placeholders, characters, teams and test data, with style and count options. Everything is produced locally.

random-picker.name: Random Picker
random-picker.intro: Pick one item at random from your options, with multiple draws and a no-repeat mode — for deciding where to eat or who speaks first.

reaction-tester.name: Reaction Time Test
reaction-tester.intro: Click the target as soon as it appears to measure your reaction time, with average and best scores tracked — a self-test for hand-eye coordination.

riddle-generator.name: Riddle Generator
riddle-generator.intro: Draws riddles at random from a puzzle bank or by keyword, with answers you can reveal — for party interaction and language fun.

rock-paper-scissors.name: Rock Paper Scissors
rock-paper-scissors.intro: Play rock-paper-scissors against the computer with a built-in scoreboard and win-streak record. Casual and fully offline.

sequence-memory.name: Sequence Memory
sequence-memory.intro: A sequence is played or shown and you reproduce it exactly, with adjustable length and speed. Trains sequential and working memory and records your best length.

sequence-puzzle.name: Sequence Puzzle
sequence-puzzle.intro: Given a number or shape sequence, infer the next item — covering arithmetic, geometric and pattern problems, with explanations you can study.

shape-memory.name: Shape Memory
shape-memory.intro: Shapes flash at certain positions and you restore them in order or in place, with rising difficulty to train visual-spatial memory.

sliding-puzzle.name: Sliding Puzzle
sliding-puzzle.intro: Classic number sliding puzzle: move the scrambled tiles until they run in order, in either number or picture mode. Good for logic training.

snake-game.name: Snake Game
snake-game.intro: Classic Snake: steer with the arrow keys to eat and grow while avoiding collisions, with a high-score record. No network connection needed.

solitaire.name: Solitaire (Klondike)
solitaire.intro: Classic Klondike Solitaire — move every card by suit from Ace to King onto the foundation piles.

space-shooter.name: Space Shooter
space-shooter.intro: Vertical space shooter: fly, shoot and wipe out wave after wave of alien enemies while collecting power-ups to beat your high score.

stats-3.name: Palm Size vs Height Correlation
stats-3.intro: Enter palm length and height samples to compute the correlation coefficient and judge how strong the relationship is. A light-hearted statistics demo.

stats-blink.name: Blink Counter (Auto Timer)
stats-blink.intro: Counts blinks per unit of time with automatic timing, for eye-care reminders, focus observation and self-checking your screen habits.

step-stride.name: Stride & Speed Converter
step-stride.intro: Estimate walking speed from cadence and step length, or derive the cadence and step length needed for a target speed — for walking pace and gait analysis.

sudoku-generator.name: Sudoku Generator
sudoku-generator.intro: Creates printable Sudoku puzzles with answers, letting you choose difficulty and the number of givens. Good for logic training and leisure; the board can be copied freely.

tetris.name: Tetris
tetris.intro: Classic line-clearing puzzle: move, rotate and drop tetrominoes to fill and clear rows for points. Keyboard and touch supported, with speed rising by level.

tic-tac-toe.name: Tic Tac Toe
tic-tac-toe.intro: Play against the computer or a second player, with automatic win and draw detection. Pure front-end, no network needed.

tongue-twister.name: Tongue Twister
tongue-twister.intro: Shows tongue twisters at random with a read-aloud timer, spanning different sound difficulties — for pronunciation practice and voice warm-ups.

typing-rhythm.name: Typing Rhythm Test
typing-rhythm.intro: Type the sample text character by character; the tool records the interval between keystrokes and scores the stability of your typing rhythm.

wedding-banquet.name: Wedding Banquet Calculator
wedding-banquet.intro: Estimate tables, seats and per-table dish quantities from your guest count, so both the banquet seating plan and the catering order come out right.

whack-a-mole.name: Whack-a-Mole
whack-a-mole.intro: Classic Whack-a-Mole: click the moles as they pop up within the time limit to score. Trains reaction and hand-eye coordination, with a high-score record.

word-scramble.name: Word Scramble
word-scramble.intro: English words are scrambled and you restore them within limited hints — builds vocabulary and spelling, with score and hint usage tracked.

zodiac-match.name: Zodiac Compatibility
zodiac-match.intro: Pick your sign and theirs to see a compatibility score and reading, computed from the four-element sign affinity algorithm.
